text:
nina: quick heads-up — ran the python quickstart and hit an SDK vs curl parity issue. SDK dropped the X-Client-Context header and admin.list_models() returned 403 while curl to /v1/admin/models works.

rahul: can you paste the minimal repro and what you see on the server?

nina: curl that works from docs:```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" -H \"X-Client-Context: onboarding-demo\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate -d '{\"model\":\"lite-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```

nina: python SDK quickstart I used:```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
client.text.generate(model='lite-1', input='hello')
```

nina: server logs for SDK request show no X-Client-Context header and a separate call `GET /admin/models` from the SDK returned 403 while curl `GET /v1/admin/models` with same token returned 200.

carmen: two likely causes: 1) header whitelist in the SDK HTTP layer is out-of-date and strips X-Client-* headers; 2) admin client basepath/version mismatch (sdk might be calling /admin/v0 or /admin without /v1 prefix).

rahul: also observed SDK retry behavior — it retried a POST generate twice on a transient 502 which caused duplicate outputs for the demo. curl does not retry by default.

nina: workaround used: set REDWOOD_PY_SDK_RETRIES=0 for the demo and fall back to requests.post to preserve headers. Not great for onboarding.

carmen: action items: 1) rahul to open GH issue with network dumps + server logs for header drop + retry case; 2) carmen will scan SDK admin client basepath and PR fix if it's using wrong prefix; 3) update quickstart docs and onboarding checklist to mention the env toggles and the temporary workaround.

rahul: opening issue now with repro steps + curl vs sdk bodies + trace. I'll include suggested labels: area/sdk, priority/p1, repro/quickstart.

tooling-bot: Created issue redwood/sdk#623: \"Python SDK strips X-Client-* headers; admin basepath mismatch; default retry policy retries POSTs\" https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/623

nina: thanks — once the basepath/header fixes land can we cut a patch release and update the quickstart package? This blocked a partner onboarding earlier today.

carmen: will aim for a patch and unit tests for header passthrough and admin path. Also propose adding an explicit `headers` option on client calls so quickstarts can pass through arbitrary headers without touching the whitelist.

nina: perfect. I'll add a short FAQ entry in the onboarding doc pointing to the issue and the env workaround for now. :thumbsup:
